stage: Stage-A query-independent official-SAM3 multiscale region hierarchy precursor
objective: Recover object-part-group proposal support from legal registered source or mapping RGB before any text query, benchmark annotation, target RGB, or evaluation RGB is opened.

allowed: source-authority-listed registered source or mapping RGB bytes
fixed crop, point-grid, filtering, deduplication, and containment contracts
forbidden: query text or query-specific point/box/mask prompts
per-scene or per-query threshold selection from benchmark metrics
causal_scope.persistent_output: query-independent per-source-view binary proposal masks and their 2-D containment graph

registered_method.crop_box_convention: full-image xyxy half-open, first and last intervals edge anchored, no coverage gaps
registered_method.point_placement: deterministic pixel-cell centres in row-major order
registered_method.artificial_crop_edge_policy: reject when the proposal box is within two pixels of a crop edge that is not an image edge
registered_method.deduplication: per-crop then global quality-times-stability ranked suppression only for IoU above 0.85 and near-equal area ratio at least 0.90; proper containment is preserved
registered_method.containment_graph: each child selects the smallest proposal containing at least 0.90 of child pixels and having at least 1.05 times child area

per_mask_outputs: crop index, crop layer, crop xyxy, crop scale xy, and crop-window area fraction
global prompt index and official multimask candidate index
full-image proposal box and area fraction
crop area fraction and crop/artificial-edge flags
direct parent index, containment, area ratio, and parent-child edge list
fail_closed_identity: source authority file SHA-256 and exact information policy
producer script, hierarchy module, and official-SAM loader source SHA-256 closure
atomic output commit and output SHA-256 manifest
exact identity validation before skip-existing reuse
stage_a_acceptance_gates: all requested authority-listed frames pass source, checkpoint, runtime, producer, and generation-contract validation
every stored mask is non-empty, lies in the source raster, and has aligned per-mask metadata
no retained mask touches an artificial crop edge under the registered tolerance
parent edges are acyclic by strictly increasing area and satisfy the registered containment rule
at least two crop layers retain proposals and the hierarchy contains non-trivial parent-child edges on the development source cohort
single-scale and multiscale proposal coverage are reported without opening benchmark ground truth
downstream_non_promotion_rule: Stage-A construction alone is not a benchmark method improvement. It may advance to exact-MPR lifting and cross-view hierarchy only after the gates above pass; benchmark promotion still requires a frozen paired evaluation.

gpu_smoke.resource_policy: GPU 4 was not used because it became saturated by the existing SPIn/ScanNet queue; GPU 0 was used only after two stable polls showed 15134 MiB free.
gpu_smoke.configuration_delta_from_registered_full: one frame, one crop layer after full image, 4 points per side, downscale factor 2, maximum 128 masks
gpu_smoke.interpretation: The smoke validates official-decoder execution, exact crop/remap plumbing, artificial-edge filtering, and complete identity binding. Its deliberately sparse grid does not pass the registered multiscale coverage or non-trivial hierarchy gates and is not a method or accuracy result.
